text: Not instantaneous, it should feel like a spray, it has a travel time to fill the cone and a linger time during which is produce damages
Implementation is complete and all automated checks pass. Native presentation/controller playtest remains the only closeout gate; keep BRL-0041 in doing until the user accepts that evidence.

Playtest feedback: tick-backed Balance Lab fields reject ordinary decimal entry because the browser and client validator require an already exact 1/60-second multiple. Accept decimal seconds and snap to the nearest authoritative tick; retain exact-integer validation for unscaled integer fields.
